hypotheses.justification: For any morphism g from a reduced scheme, g.ker equals the vanishing ideal I of its range closure without quasi-compactness. The inequality g.ker ≤ I follows from Hom.range_subset_ker_support, closedness of support, and IdealSheafData.le_support_iff_le_vanishingIdeal. Conversely, a section in I.ideal U vanishes on the range, so its pullback has empty basic open (Scheme.preimage_basicOpen). Reducedness makes this pullback zero by eq_zero_of_basicOpen_eq_bot. Thus IdealSheafData.le_ofIdeals_iff and the definition of Hom.ker give I ≤ g.ker. Apply this equality pointwise and retain the existing vanishingIdeal_iSup argument. Empty sources cause no exception; for an empty indexing type both sides are ⊤ by vanishingIdeal_bot.
